turns.question: Our project concerns developing and packaging a custom file source plugin. For the planned deployment, set connector name to cedar-import-17. Which value should we use, and which ordering of processing and offset saving gives at-least-once consumption?
turns.standalone_question: For this Kafka project, our project concerns developing and packaging a custom file source plugin. For the planned deployment, set connector name to cedar-import-17. Which value should we use, and which ordering of processing and offset saving gives at-least-once consumption?
asks: project connector name
Which ordering of processing and offset saving gives at-least-once consumption?
turns.answer: The project connector name is cedar-import-17. Read, process, then save the position gives at-least-once consumption.
key_facts: The project connector name is cedar-import-17.
Read, process, then save the position gives at-least-once consumption.

evidence.quote: set connector name to cedar-import-17
| Read → process → save position | First messages are re-processed by the new owner | **At least once** |

review.memo: 현재 설정값과 문서의 처리 순서를 정확히 묻고 답한다.
